title: populus rotundifolia var. bonatii
intro: Populus rotundifolia var. bonatii, commonly known as African cottonwood or African white poplar, is a deciduous tree species native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Populus rotundifolia var. bonatii include being an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
